user.title: Connect to the inverter's Wi-Fi dongle

data_description.host: IP address of the Wi-Fi dongle plugged into the inverter.
data_description.port: The dongle listens on 8000 unless it has been changed.
data_description.datalog: The 10-character serial on the dongle's label, also shown in the LuxPower app as the datalog.
data_description.legacy_entity_ids: Give entities the IDs lxp-bridge's MQTT entities had (sensor.lxp_<serial>_...), so their history and the energy dashboard carry on. Delete the old MQTT entities first.

error.cannot_connect: The dongle did not answer. Check the host, port and serial.
error.legacy_ids_taken: The lxp-bridge entity IDs are still in use ({entities}, ...). Stop lxp-bridge, clear its MQTT discovery messages and delete its entities first, or untick the option.

abort.already_configured: This inverter is already set up.
abort.wrong_inverter: That dongle is connected to a different inverter.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read power, energy and temperatures.
data_description.holding_interval: How often to re-read the inverter's settings. They are also read after every change made from Home Assistant.
data_description.read_bms: Cell voltages and temperatures, current limits and cycle count as reported by the battery. Turn off if your battery does not report them.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Reads every reading and setting from the inverter now.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter
config_entry_id.description: Only this inverter; all of them if left empty.
